observations.body: The closing sin statement belongs to an argument about food, conscience, stumbling, love, peace, and building up another person.
observations.label: Whatever is not of faith is sin

observations.body: The passage presents saving, forgiving, taking away, convicting, sending, bearing, dying, rising, and making free as the scene's observable response or movement.

observations.body: The passage places christ spirit and authority beside saving, forgiving, taking away, convicting, sending, bearing, dying, rising, and making free.

payload.posture: Read Romans 14:13–23 as evidence about sin, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the source states a relation among sin, Jesus Christ, the Spirit, faith, death, or life without supplying one complete theory
